name: Ahio
overview: Ahio is identified in Scripture primarily as a Levite who played a key role in transporting the ark of the covenant, specifically by driving the new cart that carried it from the house of Abinadab in Gibeah (2 Samuel 6:3-4; 1 Chronicles 13:7). He is also noted as a son of Abinadab and is mentioned among the Benjamites, being the son of Jehiel, which highlights his tribal lineage (1 Chronicles 8:14, 8:31, 9:37). These passages emphasize Ahio's service in the sacred task of accompanying and guiding the ark, reflecting the Levites' responsibility in honoring and safeguarding God's presence among His people.
